text:
mike (engineering): Quick review please 1.4.2 release notes + internal announce. EU cutover window 03/27 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pin/rollback wording checks?

sara (product): Looks good. Do we have explicit canary thresholds?

ana (eng-sre): Please list exact pins (model + infra). Ops needs them.

mike (engineering): Added: Pinned model=redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2 (INT4), Fallback=redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.1, Infra=eu-dedicated-gpu-pool-7.

elaine (docs): Ill tidy bullets and craft the short internal blurb. Paste preferred blurb?

sara (product): Draft blurb: "Heads-up: rolling v1.4.2 (improved tail latency, ~12% token cost reduction). Canary in EU 03/27 02:00 UTC. Auto-fallback to v1.4.1 if thresholds breached."

daniel (oncall): Need concrete thresholds for runbook.

mike (engineering): Proposed thresholds: Errors >=3% 5xx/malformed over 5m -> abort, Latency p95 >700ms sustained 10m -> abort, Quality eval drop >2% on canary prompts -> rollback.

ana (eng-sre): Add canary safety: stop if failed shards>1 or GPU OOM rate>0.5% across pool. Start 5% traffic cap.

mike (engineering): Canary plan: 5% for 30m, 25% for 30m, then ramp to 100%. Auto-abort if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: job_id=deploy-1742209999-1 target=eu-dedicated-gpu-pool-7 model=redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2

deploy-bot: Canary started 1 5% traffic. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/canary/1742209999

elaine (docs): Internal announce text (short): "Heads-up: rolling v1.4.2 to EU (canary 03/27 02:00 UTC). Lowers tail latency and cost. Canary staged; rollback thresholds set. Oncall: @daniel, @ana. See canary dashboard for metrics"

sara (product): Add: "Do not escalate externally unless rollback occurs."

daniel (oncall): Preparing runbook snippet + quick rollback command:
```
# rollback to stable
deploy-bot rollback --job deploy-1742209999-1 --to redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.1
```

mike (engineering): Runbook note: automated abort pages eng and marks job aborted. Manual rollback after 5m triage unless P1.

ana (eng-sre): Please include postmortem template link in internal announce.

elaine (docs): Added template link and 1-paragraph summary section.

mike (engineering): Final checklist before internal blast: release notes (elaine), pins declared (mike), thresholds (daniel), deploy queued (deploy-bot), announce copy ready (sara/elaine).

sara (product): I'll send internal announce T-30 and embargo external comms until stage 3 stable.

an a (eng-sre): infra +1 embargo.

daniel (oncall): oncall ready; rollback command staged.

deploy-bot: Canary @5m: errors 0.4%, p95 310ms, GPU mem 78%

elaine (docs): Good numbers. Ill post 30m checkpoint update.

sara (product): If 30m stable, Ill push external comms draft to comms channel.

mike (engineering): Closing thread; will update after checkpoint. :thumbsup:
